skill: Signposting a presentation and handling questions

words.def: to reach an agreement where both people give up something
words.ex: We had to {compromise} on when to have guests over.

words.def: an agreed standard of behaviour in a shared home
words.ex: One {household norm} in our flat is that everyone washes up within an hour.

words.def: to find a solution to a problem or disagreement
words.ex: We sat down together to {resolve} the argument about the heating.

words.def: treating other people, their space and needs with care
words.ex: It's important to be {respectful} of your housemates' sleep schedules.

words.def: a schedule showing whose turn it is to clean
words.ex: The {cleaning rota} means everyone does their fair share.

words.def: a feeling of stress between people who disagree
words.ex: There was some {tension} when nobody did the washing up.

words.def: to share a home with someone and manage daily life together
words.ex: It can take time to learn how to {live with} someone new.

words.def: in a true and open way, without hiding things
words.ex: You need to talk {honestly} about problems before they get worse.
